name: A Lady's Pyre
source:
When I think of my bright and happy future, I can only imagine you right there beside me. 

The hero storms the castle.

The woman raises her blade. 

[From [url=https://uraalice.itch.io/ladys-pyre]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当我想到我光明幸福的未来时，我只能想象你就在我身边。

英雄冲进城堡。

女人举起了刀。

[来自[url=https://uraalice.itch.io/ladys-pyre]itch.io[/url]]
